title: Legal Process
description: Charges, instruments, pleas, verdicts, sentences, and forfeiture — CASE investigation plus legalproc (and CAC legal-outcomes when the case is a crime against children).
mission: Keep charging and sentencing queryable and distinct from the investigative narrative so docket ingestion can land in the right existing classes.

Person.notes: Person/Identity is the bearer. Victim and defendant are Roles, not types of person.

recipe_skeleton.summary: Investigation + Identity/Role + ChargingInstrument + CriminalCharge + disposition nodes.
steps: Create Investigation (legalproc:caseIdentifier holds the docket number when known).
Create Person/Identity for defendants and victims; attach Role nodes (do not subclass Person as Defendant).
Create ChargingInstrument and CriminalCharge with statute citations.
Add Plea / Verdict / Sentence / ForfeitureOrder as they occur.
Wire Relationship kinds Charged_With, Victim_Of, Member_Of.
For CAC cases, prefer CAC legal-outcomes classes alongside legalproc.
